text: For the incident write-up: at what time did Gideon call both Hartford gate lanes working again on 3 Aug, and which trailer was the first check-in once kiosk 1 came back?
reply_text:
@nadia.fennimore, answered in #inc-vtg-hartford:

- Gideon posted at 11:08 AM on Aug 3 that both lanes were working "as of Aug 3, 11:07." So the time is 11:07 AM, per his post.
- The first check-in after kiosk 1 came back was trailer 8836, per Mateo's 11:03 AM post.

The channel only shows one check-in, so the write-up may want to confirm trailer 8836 against the dispatch log.
